a novel fiber was fabricated for the extraction of trace levels of phenols in water samples by the headspace solid- phase microextraction.
a novel solid-phase microextractions fiber based on carbon nanotube and layered double hydroxide was prepared and evaluated for the headspace extraction of phenolic compound from water samples.
a novel carbon nanotube layered double hydroxide solid-phase microextration fiber was prepared by an electrostatic force for the determination of phenols from different water samples.

the development of a novel solid-phase microextration fiber, which was prepared by the in situ growth of the carbon nanotube on a layered double hydroxide.

the synthesis of carbon nanotubes/layered double-hydroxide nanocomposites and the fabrication of a novel solid-phase microex-traction fiber for the extraction of the phenolic compounds from environmental water samples.
the preparation of a carbon nanotubes/layered double-hydroxide nanocomposites and their use for headspace solid-phase extraction of phenols from the water samples.

the carbon nanotube-based solid-phase microextration fibers can be considered as a promising and efficient extraction tool for the determination of phenols in environmental water samples.

a new carbon nanotube-based solid-phase microextration fiber was prepared for the determination of phenolic compounds in environmental samples.
